Commit requires exact final-audit candidate path set and SHA256 for every input, current config counts/issues, no symlinks, clean staging and base/branch match. Final audit itself is explicitly excluded from its self-hash input set but included in commit receipt.
OpenPR binds exact local head/tree/clean state, live main and unique owned branch; post-review requires matching hosted peer head/tree before COMMENT mutation.
Enqueue binds required CI, reviewed COMMENT, exact preflight identity/log/required commands and immediately observed live main; retains race limitation and native queue.
Cleanup deletes only owned branch after exact MERGED head/tree/parent and clean worktree, with remote force-with-lease matching expected head; no worktree deletion.
Original-main sync requires fresh postmerge and five hosted runs, unchanged hidden/ignored-inclusive snapshot and retained tag; fast-forward only and no autostash.

Fresh clone preflight/postmerge excludes topic commit, retains tag, asserts exact tree/parent, requires canonical checks and coverage; safe unique clone/receipt paths and constrained archive extraction.

Paginated hosted file API explicitly uses --paginate --slurp; verifies all-page complete exact set, duplicate/missing/extra status checks and every blob against immutable tree:path. Hosted check gates exact five workflow run/job identities.
